The project depends on axios 0.18.1, which falls within the vulnerable range (< 0.21.2) for CVE‑2021‑3749. Axios is imported in `src/utils/request.js` and used by the API modules to make HTTP calls from the browser. Because the repository contains only front‑end code, the vulnerable Node‑specific adapter has not been shown to be reachable, and no user‑controlled inputs that would trigger the ReDoS pattern are evident. Consequently, version match = true, but actual exploitability in the current codebase remains unknown.
One historical Axios ReDoS advisory only. Other advisories remain; no compatibility tests run. Browser call sites do not prove reachability of the vulnerable Node adapter.
The proposed one‑line diff upgrades the `axios` dependency from version 0.18.1 to 0.21.2, which addresses the GHSA‑cph5‑m8f7‑6c5x (CVE‑2021‑3749) ReDoS vulnerability. No other changes are introduced.
